applies_to.quote: To All Authorised Dealers Madam / Sir, Non-Resident Deposits - Comprehensive Single Return (NRD-CSR)(R012): Submission under CIMS Sankalan Portal

answer.action: Authorised dealer banks must submit the monthly Non-Resident Deposits Comprehensive Single Return (NRD-CSR) (R012) on the CIMS Sankalan portal using the specified channels on or before the 10th of each following month.
answer.action_quote: The NRD-CSR report may be submitted on or before 10th of the month following the month to which the NRD data pertains.
answer.amends: A.P. (DIR Series) Circular No. 19 dated August 07, 2013
